film.title: Film Studio
film.subtitle: AI film pipeline · Script → Shot image → Image-to-video → Voiceover → BGM → Compose
film.emptyHint: Click "New Project" to start your first AI film from a one-line idea.
film.delConfirm: Delete project "{title}"? All shots and artifacts are unrecoverable.
film.fIdeaPh: Describe the story / style / pace in a paragraph…
film.presetPortraitDesc: Douyin / TikTok / Shorts / Reels short video
film.channelOnlyHint: Configure a video/voiceover channel in the gateway first
film.genStoryboardHint: Regenerate the storyboard — existing shots will be overwritten. Continue?
film.timelineEmpty: Generate the storyboard to get shots
film.noShot: Click a shot in the timeline to select it
film.bgmPromptPh: e.g. light piano + strings, warm and healing
film.finalEmpty: Compose after shot videos / voiceovers and BGM are ready
film.capsOfflineTip: NexOS service unreachable (capability probe failed) — generation disabled
film.charEmpty: No characters yet — create one so shots can bind and inject consistency references
film.charDescPh: Hair / color / outfit / age & vibe… injected into every image prompt
film.charDescHint: The more specific the description, the stronger the cross-shot consistency
film.charVoiceHint: A bound character's voice is passed through to the TTS channel; unset falls back to global default
film.charVoiceTip: TTS voice (passed through per character once bound)
film.charGenTip: Generate a portrait via the existing image pipeline (prompt defaults from description)
film.charDelConfirm: Delete character “{name}”? Portrait and shot bindings will be removed.
film.charNoneHint: No characters yet — create one in the Characters panel to bind
film.refInjectTip: Channel source injects portraits (reference_images); local sd-turbo uses prompt-only mode
film.voiceTip: TTS voice: first bound character with a voice → global default (env/alloy)
film.exportDirHint: Empty = export to the project directory; must be an existing absolute path.
film.exportDirPrecheck: The export directory must be an absolute path starting with / (~ is not expanded; the backend does not auto-create directories — the parent directory must already exist; mkdir it first if missing)
film.previewEmpty: Generate the storyboard first — it previews here once ready
film.previewPlaceholder: No shot image yet — Ken Burns easing shows here after generation
film.previewFinalMissing: Loading final cut… (or not composed yet)
film.flowWorkbenchTip: Original five-zone workbench: shot panel / preview monitor / multi-track timeline
film.storySourceEmpty: No source texts yet — import a txt or let AI write the story
film.storyPromptPh: e.g. Turn the source into an 800-char story draft, warm and healing…
film.storyDraftEmpty: No story draft yet — start with AI generation or source import
film.storyImportMax: File exceeds the {mb}MB guard (server-side, tunable via NEXOS_FILM_SOURCE_MAX_MB)
film.storyImportBig: Uploading a large file… ({mb}MB, b64 upload may be slow)
film.storyImportNotText: Content is not decodable text (tried UTF-8 and GB18030)
film.storyPipelineHint: Import → Clean → Chapterize → Embed (chapters required) → Profile chars (side step)
film.storyChaptersEmpty: No chapters yet — select a source and run “Chapterize”
film.storyProfileEmpty: No character profiles yet — select a source and run “Profile chars”
film.storyTruncated: Content too long — showing first {n} chars
film.storyPipelineNeedsSource: Select a source text on the left first
film.storyNoModel: Chapterize/profile need a chat model — pick one above
film.storyEmbNotSet: No embedding model configured (models page, emb slot)
film.storyEmbHint: The selected model has no embeddings capability: locally you need an instance started with --task embed (e.g. bge-m3); for channels, an /embeddings API is required
film.sbOverwriteHint: Regenerate the storyboard from the story? Existing shots will be overwritten.
film.sbWorkbenchTip: Edit shots / generate image-video-voice / preview in the workbench
film.sbEmpty: No storyboard yet — generate from the story to preview here
film.sbNeedStory: Prepare the story first (import source or AI write) on the Story page
film.sbCastEmptyTip: No casting objects bound yet — bind on the Casting page or workbench
film.sbgToggleHint: Chapter / cast / voices / shot count / duration (optional)
film.sbgCastEmpty: No character objects yet — create or AI-extract them on the Casting page
film.sbgVoiceTip: TTS voice (written to the character card voice)
film.sbgVoiceHint: Changes are written to the casting object voice immediately (used by storyboard TTS)
film.sbgShotCountRange: Shot count must be between 5 and 12
film.sbgPendingNote: Note: chapter range / cast / shot count / duration are sent with the generate request and consumed by storyboard/generate; voices are written to casting objects immediately (effective now).
film.castExtractEmpty: No extraction report yet — AI extract pulls six object groups from the story
film.castObjectsEmpty: No objects in this group — AI extract or create one
film.castDetailHint: Click an object in the list to view details
film.castCardVoiceNote: voice passes through to TTS for characters
film.castViewGenTip: Generate for this slot view (prompt defaults from description)
film.castCzPartsHint: Replace a part and regenerate — other parts stay consistent
film.castCzPartsHintAlt: Replace a part and regenerate — other parts stay consistent; toggle Form to switch animal/plant slot sets
film.castCzGenMain: Generate main view from current parts
film.castBlenderPromptPh: Scene description, e.g. a xianxia altar atop snowy peaks in cold morning light… (empty = composed from object card)
film.castBlenderHint: LLM writes a Blender script, then renders the 3D scene still locally (Blender required; two-stage task: script + render)
film.castCzGenNote: Unsaved part changes will be saved with this generation
film.castCzPromptPreview: Prompt preview (backend composes the same template)
film.castDescPh: Appearance/setting — the more specific, the better consistency
film.castDelConfirm: Delete object "{name}"? Views and claims are removed too.
film.castMotionNotePh: e.g. martial-arts reference clip note (goes into local-tier prompt)
film.castMotionHint: Injected into the generation chain: channel tier sends motion_video / motion_skeleton extension fields (videos over 8MB switch to a file path); local tier appends "object name + note" to the prompt.
film.castCameraDescribePh: e.g. camera tilts up from the feet to a face close-up, slowly pushing in
film.castCameraHint: Injected at generation: presets pass through camera_control (Kling v1 semantics; ignored by other channels) plus a "Camera: …" prompt prefix; describe mode only uses the prompt prefix.
film.motionBadgeTip: The motion reference / camera movement of the action objects bound to this shot are injected into video generation
film.bgmListEmpty: BGM library is empty — import or create an entry
film.bgmTriggerPh: global or a scene name, e.g. opening / chase / ending
film.bgmErrFile: Pick an mp3 file (or use "AI generate")
film.bgmGenEntryTip: Create the entry first, then generate audio by mood
film.bgmFormHint: Import requires a file; AI generate only needs a trigger
film.cpDistEmpty: No finals yet — versions appear here after composing
film.cpCacheEmpty: No drafts — trial outputs are promoted here via "Commit"
film.cpCacheDiscardTip: Hide from list only (no backend delete endpoint for cache yet)
film.costBadgeTip: Calls and estimated cost (click for stage/channel breakdown)
film.costCurrencyNote: Estimate — computed from channel unit prices and metering, for reference only
film.ownUnclaimedTip: No owner yet — click "Claim" to become the owner
film.ownMembersEmpty: No members yet — add names to divide the work
film.ownRemoveConfirm: Remove member "{name}"? Their section claims stay until reassigned.
film.whoAmITip: Author of write operations (author field; visible in activity)
film.collabTip: Concurrent edits resolve to the last save (no locks in v1 — real-time collab awaits P1 git repos)
film.actEmpty: No activity yet — backend records write operations (ring buffer, 200)
film.actHint: Recent operations (time / author / action / target) — "I am" is the author
film.wbBgmEmpty: No BGM tracks yet — create or import on the Audio page first
film.viewLink: Open this view in a new tab (shareable link)
film.storySourceBusyTip: This file is busy ({state}) — wait for it to finish before starting another pipeline run
film.storyNeedChaptersTip: Chapterize first: embedding requires chapter structure (chapterize falls back to auto-segmentation)
film.storySbFromChapterTip: Open storyboard page with chapter {n} prefilled (corpus = this chapter only)
film.sbgChapterNoChapters: Not chapterized yet — chapterize first to enable per-chapter generation
film.sbgChapterTip: Selected = generate from that chapter corpus only (no full text); default = full story
film.sbgChapterAllHint: Default: generate from the full story (story.md)
film.sbgChapterSelectedHint: Generate from the selected chapters only — no content from other chapters
film.sbgChapterPrefilled: Storyboard chapter prefilled to chapter {range} — hit "Generate from story" to use it

shotgen.title: Shot Gen
shotgen.advancedTip: Open the full filmmaking pipeline: FilmHub lobby / studio / collaboration (storyboard · images · video · voice · compose)
shotgen.modelChipTip: Generations go through the video capability channel: {name}
shotgen.videoMissing: Video generation requires a video channel model — configure it first
shotgen.promptPh: Describe the shot you want, e.g.: a xianxia duel on a snowy summit, a white-robed swordsman riding a blade through the storm…
shotgen.promptHint: Timeline-style structured prompts are supported (see the 0-4s / 4-8s pattern in the inspiration presets)
shotgen.imageHint: png / jpeg / webp, ≤10MB — first-frame reference for image → video
shotgen.imageBadType: Reference image must be png / jpeg / webp
shotgen.errImage: Pick a reference image first for image → video
shotgen.inspRoadPrompt: Cinematic road shot: a vintage sedan gliding down a dusk desert highway, low-angle tracking camera, golden dust rising, thunderclouds rolling in the distance, widescreen texture, natural light, 35mm film grain, one 8-second take
shotgen.inspWhalePrompt: A glowing whale glides through a sea of clouds at sunset, stardust falling from its back; the camera tilts up slowly from below the clouds, the fluke stirs waves of mist — dreamlike, epic, soft light, wide composition
shotgen.qualityNativeTip: Quality is decided natively by the selected channel (no re-encoding)
shotgen.errSeed: Seed must be a non-negative integer (empty or 0 = random)
shotgen.worksEmptyHint: Type one line of imagination on the Create tab to generate your first clip.
shotgen.copyTip: Copy the full prompt — paste it back on Create to tweak and regenerate
shotgen.regenerateTip: Refill Create tab: prompt / aspect / duration / seed

filmhub.tagline: Film project hub · Create with AI, like writing code
filmhub.searchEmptyHint: Try another keyword, or clear the search to see all projects.
filmhub.richModeTip: Concurrently fetch members / latest activity / cost for the 12 most recent projects (any failure silently degrades to a plain card)
filmhub.cardStageTip: Stage progress is derived on the client from artifacts; the README stage is authoritative once you open the project
filmhub.hubViewTip: Browse the project file tree like a repository (story / storyboard / casting / dist …)
filmhub.noFileSelected: Click a file in the tree to preview it
filmhub.binaryUnsupported: Preview not supported for this file type (beyond text / image / audio / video)
filmhub.openInFlowTip: Jump to the matching flow page: story.md → Story / storyboard.json → Storyboard / casting/* → Casting (object selected) / audio/* → Audio / dist·final → Compose
filmhub.guideIntro: Treat the film project as a repository: agents read/write the files surface (GET tree / PUT single file), then trigger generation endpoints — create films like writing code.
filmhub.guidePut: Write storyboard.json (files surface, b64 envelope + author)
filmhub.guideApply: After an agent edits files: reload on the matching flow page (e.g. Storyboard), or POST /api/v1/film/projects/import to import from a directory.
filmhub.previewEmpty: Click a file in the tree above to preview it here
filmhub.previewComplex: Video / binary content — use “Browse all” for the full view

models.navTip: Project model settings: default model source for 8 capabilities (chat/image/video/tts/music/asr/emb/vl)
models.title: Models
models.tip: Set a default model source per capability: pick "Project default" on generate actions to use it; truth lives in models.json (agents can read/write directly).
models.empty: No config snapshot yet (backend may not be ready)
models.useChat: Story / storyboard / extract / clean / profile text generation
models.reservedTip: Config-ready, awaiting consumers (no generation endpoint reads it yet)
models.noChannels: No enabled channels (add one in API Gateway first)
models.modelPh: Defaults to the channel's first model
models.localChatHint: Local source uses the running LLM instance (now: {name})
models.localSdHint: Local source = sd-turbo image kernel (spawned on demand)
models.addApiFootnote: Submitting creates a gateway channel and sets it as the default model source for that capability; manage channels on the API Gateway page.
models.addApiDone: Channel "{name}" created and set as {cap} default
models.routeHint: Matched top-down (exact > longest prefix); automatic failover, finally falls back to the default
models.routeEmpty: No routing rules yet (empty = everything goes to the default model source)
models.routeAgentHint: Agent dual channel: PUT /api/v1/film/projects/{id}/models with a routes field (full replacement), or PUT files/models.json directly (file is the source of truth)

collab.navTip: PR/Issues: issue tracking with pipeline-stage attribution, PR diff & merge
collab.title: Collab
collab.issuesEmpty: No issues yet — file one from a failed pipeline task in the task center, or click "New issue"
collab.prsEmpty: No PRs yet — branch, edit the storyboard, then open a merge request here
collab.stageTip: Pipeline stage attribution (auto-filled by one-click from-task filing)
collab.refsTip: Linked issues that auto-close on merge
collab.errBranch: Pick a branch (create one on the workbench git panel first)
collab.stageHint: Stage name is used for failure attribution — auto-filled by from-task
collab.refsHint: These issues auto-close when the PR merges (unknown numbers skipped)
collab.noBranches: No other branches yet (create one first)
collab.mergeConfirmText: Checks out the base branch and merges with --no-ff; the canvas updates accordingly. Server-truth lists (activity/issues/prs) auto union-merge on conflict; business-file conflicts return 409.
collab.fromTaskTip: Turn this pipeline stage failure into an issue (error + log tail + source file)
collab.fromTaskNoTask: No failed task found for this source (may have been cleaned up)

toast.submitted: Submitted — you'll be notified when it finishes
